mapper.insert: INSERT INTO track_import_log (status, file_id, import_count, import_fail_count, `result`, create_man, create_man_id) VALUES (#{status}, #{fileId}, #{importCount}, #{importFailCount}, #{result}, #{createMan}, #{createManId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, status, file_id, import_count, import_fail_count, `result`, create_man_id, create_man, create_date FROM track_import_log WHERE is_deleted = false

SELECT id, status, file_id, import_count, import_fail_count, `result`, create_man_id, create_man, create_date FROM track_import_log WHERE create_man_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = false ORDER BY create_date DESC LIMIT 1
